messages:
Maya J: quick follow-up from the postmortem — pasted action list below. need owners + hard due dates so we can close the RCA. if you're taking something, reply with ETA and deps. try to avoid >2 week slips if possible.

Maya J: Actions: 1) create rollback safepoint + verify restore playbook 2) canary rollout plan for model-serving 3) storage GC + compaction script 4) perf regression test and baseline 5) alert tuning for cache miss storms

Kevin H: I can own #1 (rollback safepoint) and #4 (perf regression). ETA: EOD Wed (takes ~1 day to validate). Dep: need snapshot from infra (Juan).

Juan C: noted — I'll hand over the snapshot by Tue AM. ping me if you need a specific LSN.

Rachel W: I'll take #2 (canary rollout). ETA Thu. Question: do we want a gradual traffic ramp (25/50/75) or a one-step canary? my preference is ramped.

Samir P: ramped makes sense. I'll add a circuit-breaker rule in the routing policy. ETA Fri. Dep: need test tokens and access to the staging route.

Emily Z: I own #3 (GC/compaction). There's a small risk window — plan to run in two passes. ETA next Mon. I'll post the compaction command and a pre-check list later today.

Maya J: @Rachel W + @Samir P agreed on ramped canary — please include rollback triggers and exact SLO checks in the plan.

Kevin H: posting quick validation command for restore check:
```
# verify snapshot restore on staging
kubectl exec -it restore-check -- curl http://localhost:8080/health
```
I'll run it after Juan drops the snapshot.

ops-bot: Reminder — INC-547-RCA has 5 open actions. Autoclose scheduled in 14 days unless metadata updated.

Rachel W: will add a step-by-step canary doc with explicit success criteria + rollback triggers by tomorrow noon. linking the doc here once done.

Samir P: requested staging tokens from security yesterday, awaiting approval. Emily — can you share a time window for compaction so I can schedule routing changes?

Emily Z: compaction planned Tue 23:00–01:00 PT. Samir can schedule routing tweak at 22:45 so it lines up.

Maya J: lovely. final ask — please create/assign the matching Jira tasks (label: inc-547-rca) and paste the ticket IDs in this thread when done. that'll let ops-bot silence the autoclose.

Kevin H: created RCA-3214 for the rollback + validation. assigned to me.

Rachel W: created RCA-3215 for canary plan. assigned to me.

Emily Z: created RCA-3216 for compaction. assigned to me.

Samir P: created RCA-3217 for routing/circuit-breaker. assigned to me.

Maya J: perfect — thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with these owners and ETAs. will re-open if any of the ETAs slip beyond 48 hours. :thumbsup:
